content:
Alongside the release of the first public betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple also released updated developer beta versions of these two operating systems under new build numbers. Here are the details.

Public beta released simultaneously with updated version

Apple has released updated versions of iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 and macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 3 alongside the release of the first public beta.

The updated iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 carries the build number 24A5380l, while the updated macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3 has the build number 26A5378n.

It remains unclear why Apple has released these updated versions, as there had been no widespread reports of any major issues prior to this. The changes may be intended to address issues discovered shortly before today's public beta release, but Apple has not provided any details.

We are currently looking into these new builds in depth and will report back if we find anything noteworthy.

Found any new features in the updated build? Let us know in the comments section.
